name: AI YouTube Shorts Studio Pro v2 (Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash and Veo)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — 3 free keys + 1 paid video model

**FREE keys:**
1. `GEMINI_API_KEY` → [aistudio.google.com/apikey](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey) (script + Omni/Veo dono isi key se)
2. `PEXELS_API_KEY` → [pexels.com/api](https://www.pexels.com/api/) (fallback footage — free)
3. `JSON2VIDEO_API_KEY` → [json2video.com/get-api-key](https://json2video.com/get-api-key/) (render + Hindi voice + captions — free)
4. Last node pe **YouTube OAuth2** credential

## 🎥 VIDEO ENGINE — Config mein `VIDEO_PROVIDER` se switch karo
| Provider | Model | Cost / video (4 clips x 8s) |
|---|---|---|
| `omni` (DEFAULT) | `gemini-omni-1.1-flash` — Google ka naya GA video model (Interactions API) | ~$3.20 (₹270) |
| `veo` | `veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview` | ~$3.20 (₹270) |
| `veo` + lite | `veo-3.1-lite-generate-preview` | ~$1.60 (₹135) |

⚠️ Video generation ke liye **billing enable** hona chahiye (AI Studio → Billing → Pay as you go).
⚠️ Purana `gemini-omni-flash-preview` **30 Sept 2026 se deprecated** — isliye default `gemini-omni-1.1-flash` hai.

🎙️ Voice: `hi-IN-MadhurNeural` (male) • `hi-IN-SwaraNeural` (female) • English: `en-US-EmmaMultilingualNeural` + `LANGUAGE`=`English`

❓ **Google Flow?** Flow ka koi API nahi hai — wo manual web tool hai. Tumhari Google AI Pro subscription Flow mein Veo/Omni credits deti hai — extra clips manually Flow pe banao, automation ke liye ye template use karo.

## 🎬 Studio Pro v2 — dual video engine + free everything else

**TOPIC → publish-ready Short (~4-7 min):**

1. **Gemini 2.5 Pro** (free): SEO title, #Shorts description, tags + 4 scenes (golden hook, Hindi voiceover, cinematic video prompt, Pexels fallback keyword)
2. **Video engine** (paid, ~₹270/video):
   - **Omni 1.1 Flash** (default): Interactions API se 9:16 clips
   - ya **Veo 3.1**: predictLongRunning se 9:16 clips
   - `VIDEO_PROVIDER` = `omni` ya `veo` — Config mein ek field
3. **Smart fallback**: jo scene AI se na bane, wahan **Pexels stock** — video kabhi nahi rukti
4. **JSON2Video** (free): footage + **Hindi neural voiceover** + **auto-synced boxed captions** + golden hooks + fade transitions + **FOLLOW outro** (1080x1920)
5. Auto-poll → download → **YouTube private upload**

### ⚠️ Notes
- AI clips 2-6 min lete hain (workflow khud poll karta hai — dono engines ke liye alag proven loops)
- Video **private** upload hoti hai — review karke public karo
- 401/429 = billing enable nahi hai
- `Clips Ready` node ke output mein `ai_ok` / `ai_fallback` count dikhta hai
